note: Consolidated from checkpoint.jsonl, which is the authoritative record. run_stats_resumed.json records only the final resumed segment (17 of the 54 scoring calls); the run was interrupted twice and resumed from the checkpoint.

iptm_g12d.role: pose-quality read-out only, never a ranking term

strategies.name: B4-c6-62
strategies.rationale: hotspot collapsed onto position 6 alone - the strongest available pull of the paratope onto the mutated aspartate

strategies.name: B4-c67-65
strategies.rationale: position 6 plus its C-terminal neighbour at the batch-01/02 length that produced peptide-centred poses

strategies.name: B4-pos6-68
strategies.rationale: the S1-pos6-68 setting that produced bb13, the only design in three batches to read the carboxylate, re-run with the donor bias

strategies.name: B4-pos6-72
strategies.rationale: longer scaffold on the same pos6 hotspots at a higher MPNN temperature, for topological diversity among survivors

structure_file_caveat: scored_structures/ holds 36 files for 54 rows: the filename is {backbone}_{variant}, and the two mpnn-selected candidates per backbone share it, so the second overwrites the first. Metrics in checkpoint.jsonl are complete and unaffected; only the retained .cif for the overwritten mpnn-selected rows is lost. Both gate survivors are donor-anchored variants, whose files are unique and intact.
